text: Use Case 1 promises that an operator can disable the sweep for an individual repository, while AC18 and Out of Scope define webhook enablement as process-wide and explicitly exclude repository-keyed webhook configuration. Qualify this action by ingress—per-repository for Actions and deployment-wide for webhook—or otherwise reconcile the product contract.
